description: Return latest factor and daily/weekly TD Sequential readings for one Yahoo Finance symbol, with session, price, rules, sources and historical index evidence. Reuses /api/market/indicators?ticker=; no chart histories. Stock implied volatility and variance risk premium are null; VIX term structure, credit and yield curve are shared market context. Evidence is not validated single-stock returns. Signals are rule readings, not forecasts or investment advice; the session may still be open.

ticker.description: Yahoo Finance symbol, case-insensitive, 1–20 characters after trimming: letters, digits, . - = ^; e.g. NVDA, BRK-B or 0700.HK.

name: get_ticker_indicators

asOf.description: Latest upstream quote timestamp; not necessarily a session close.

evidence.description: Historical S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 evidence, not validated returns for this instrument.

bands.description: Bullish is checked first; any other value is neutral.

bearish.description: Holds at `above` or higher, or at `below` or lower.

bullish.description: Holds at `above` or higher, or at `below` or lower.

reading.description: The value in words, as shown on /indicators.

value.description: The quantity the bands test; a fraction when unit is percent (0.05 is 5%).

reading.description: Null when a series the rule needs is missing, e.g. implied volatility for SOX.

close.description: Latest split-adjusted daily price; not a guaranteed final closing quote.

date.description: Latest trading session, which can still be open.

title: Get ticker indicators
